sortByShootingTimeInfo.title: Sort By Date Taken
sortByShootingTimeInfo.intro: When "By Date Taken" is selected, in order to sort files, this application
sortByShootingTimeInfo.step1: tries to use DateTimeOriginal in EXIF, and if it is not available,
sortByShootingTimeInfo.foldersNote: Note that folders are sorted by their names since there is no concept of "Date Taken" of folders.

details.mostTrustworthy: DateTimeOriginal in EXIF is the most trustworthy information about the time when the photo was taken.
details.sometimesMissing: DateTimeOriginal is written in most JPEG/HEIF/TIFF files by most cameras, but sometimes it is missing.
details.modifiedTime: The file’s “Date modified” is often when the photo was taken, so it is used instead when DateTimeOriginal is missing.
details.otherFiles: Also, files other than JPEG/HEIF/TIFF do not have EXIF in the first place, so their “Date modified” is always used.

thumbnails.title: Thumbnail Quality and App Performance
thumbnails.highQualityDescription: Thumbnails are generated from the photo files. Until then, the thumbnail that a photo file already holds, if any, is shown.
thumbnails.sizeDescription: A larger size shows the thumbnails larger, but they take longer to make and more space in the thumbnail cache.
thumbnails.fastDescription: When a file such as a JPEG or PNG already holds a thumbnail, it is shown as it is. A thumbnail of 400 pixels on the longer side is generated only for a file that holds none.
